simple.meaning: חֶלְבְּנָה (chelbᵉnâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “galbanam , an odorous gum (as if fatty ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Exodus, beginning at Exodus 30:34. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֶלְבְּנָה (H2464).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: galbanam , an odorous gum (as if fatty )
definitions.full: H2464. chelbenah חֶלְבְּנָה noun feminine (Aramaic , ᵐ5 חֶלְבְּנִיתָא χαλβάνη , ᵑ9 galbanum ) — a kind of gum Exod 30:34 , ingredient of the holy incense, see Di Löw 115 .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum; sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.
